incident: Theseus #41 (BenchBox #3950, D1): on a forced dispute re-review of an unchanged patch judge() rewrote a fixed disposition to not_fixed while the published rationale still said the fix works, so the label read maintained against its own evidence and counted toward escalation.
message: Keep a disputed finding open on a forced re-review of an unchanged patch

defects.title: A forced dispute round rewrites fixed to not_fixed while the evidence still says it is fixed
defects.detail: judge() flips a fixed disposition on a disputed finding to not_fixed in a forced round, so the published label is maintained against the reviewer's own evidence and the finding counts toward escalation. The verdict should be invalid, or the finding withdrawn.
